# Purpose

Award credit for a correct beam idealization, two-force-member direction, whole-arm equilibrium, signed reactions, piecewise shear and moment functions, diagram jumps and slopes, critical-section identification, and a bounded engineering recommendation.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model assumes a straight horizontal arm, static loading, small deformation, uniform weight over the full modeled length, a frictionless pin at A, and an ideal two-force hydraulic cylinder. A complete design also requires axial force, bending stress and deflection, actuator capacity, pin and connection stresses, local geometry, fatigue, dynamics, stability, controls, and applicable safety factors.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

- context interpretation and idealization: 20%;
- whole-arm equilibrium and reactions: 25%;
- piecewise shear and moment derivation: 30%;
- diagram interpretation and critical section: 15%;
- engineering recommendation and limitations: 10%.
